subject: gk
question:
Which of the following options correctly matches column-A and column-B?

 

 
 
 
 
 
 

 **Column-A (Food component)**
 **Column-B (Enzyme involved in digestion)**
 
 

 i. Protein
 a. Amylase
 
 

 ii. Carbohydrates
 b. Lipase
 
 

 iii. Fats
 c. Trypsin
solution:
The correct answer is __**option 1: i-c, ii-a, iii-b**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Proteins** are broken down by the enzyme **Trypsin**, which is produced in the pancreas and acts in the small intestine.
 
• **Carbohydrates** are digested by **Amylase**, an enzyme found in saliva and pancreatic juice.
 
• **Fats** are digested by the enzyme **Lipase**, which is also produced in the pancreas and acts in the small intestine.
 
• Enzymes are biological catalysts that speed up the chemical reactions involved in the digestion of food.
 
• The correct matching of Column-A and Column-B is: i) Protein - Trypsin, ii) Carbohydrates - Amylase, iii) Fats - Lipase.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Proteins:** Complex molecules that are broken down into amino acids, which are essential for various body functions.
 
• **Carbohydrates:** Organic compounds that serve as a major energy source for the body, broken down into simple sugars like glucose.
 
• **Fats:** Lipid molecules that are broken down into fatty acids and glycerol, providing a concentrated energy source.
 
• **Amylase:** An enzyme that helps in the breakdown of starches into sugars, found in saliva and pancreatic juice.
 
• **Trypsin:** A protease enzyme that breaks down proteins into smaller peptides, produced by the pancreas.
 
• **Lipase:** An enzyme that catalyzes the breakdown of fats into fatty acids and glycerol, essential for fat digestion and absorption.
